# RSX

ReMap's Windows builds include a modified [reSource Xtractor (RSX)](https://github.com/R5Reloaded-ReMap/rsx) executable as a separate process.

- ReMap source repository: [`R5Reloaded-ReMap/rsx`](https://github.com/R5Reloaded-ReMap/rsx)
- Integrated revision: [`c47ef0a2c2391f28ad09f33bf7a500ccfaa3dfda`](https://github.com/R5Reloaded-ReMap/rsx/tree/c47ef0a2c2391f28ad09f33bf7a500ccfaa3dfda)
- Original upstream: [`r-ex/rsx`](https://github.com/r-ex/rsx)
- License: [GNU Affero General Public License, version 3](LICENSE)
- Third-party notices: [`thirdpartylegalnotices.txt`](https://github.com/R5Reloaded-ReMap/rsx/blob/c47ef0a2c2391f28ad09f33bf7a500ccfaa3dfda/thirdpartylegalnotices.txt)

Before publishing a binary release, provide the complete corresponding source for the exact RSX executable beside that release. The safest release artifact is an archive of the tagged RSX source tree, including its build files and third-party notices.
